intro: Velora Nitely is an undead armorsmith residing in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity. Renowned as one of the finest smiths in Lordaeron before the kingdom fell, she now puts her cold craftsmanship to work for the Forsaken and the Horde. Despite her grim existence, she attempts dry, deadpan jokes that rarely land.

p: Before the Third War devastated the north, Velora Nitely was celebrated across Lordaeron as an exceptional armorsmith. Though undeath stripped her of life and warmth, it left her technical skill untouched. Now stationed near the anvils of the Undercity's Trade Quarter, she collaborates across continents with Horde crafters like Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens. Her specialty includes reinforcing heavy battle plate, notably forging the formidable Brutal Legguards from hardened materials such as Dragonmaw shinbones.

Unlike many of her somber Forsaken kin who brood over their cursed fate, Velora maintains an appetite for levity. Unfortunately, dying seems to have thoroughly ruined her comedic timing. Her quips come across flat, morbid, and thoroughly unfunny to the living and dead alike, though she continues to crack them undeterred while working the forge.
